test_title: PYST 11: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 3 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 12 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills in 3 minutes

Pipe B empties in 12 minutes

Required work = 1/4

**Formula Used:**

Net rate = Filling rate - Emptying rate

Time = Work ÷ Rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Rate of A = 1 ÷ 3

⇒ Rate of B = 1 ÷ 12

⇒ Net rate = 1/3 - 1/12

⇒ Net rate = (4 - 1) ÷ 12 = 3 ÷ 12 = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ Time to fill full tank = 1 ÷ (1/4) = 4

⇒ Time to fill 1/4 tank = 4 ÷ 4

⇒ Time = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1 minute.**
